docs.title: My journey
docs.text:
I started writing when I was about 10 years old, giving short stories to my friends for special occasions. Those early works, however, are classified and not available for public consumption.

It wasn't until I was in college that I first learned about technical writing. Because of this, I like to be an advocate for English majors and speak to students about the possibilities associated with an English degree as well as what it's like to work in the software industry.

I still write a few short stories each year in an attempt to retain at least a small amount of creativity. I'm attempting to bake more these days and also trying to learn Greek. Oh, and during the early COVID days, I allowed my (late) dog Riley to start a blog.

docs.title: Skytree, The Machine Learning Company samples
docs.text:
Skytree provided tools for the entire machine learning model building process, from data preparation to creation and deployment. The PDFs below give a highlight of the documentation that I created, describing how to configure Skytree via Python SDK, CLI, and REST API.

Click on a link below to view a PDF of that individual writing sample.

  • Skytree Python SDK Quick Start Guide
  • Skytree Server User Guide
  • Skytree REST API Guide

docs.title: Aruba Networks samples
docs.text:
Aruba Networks, now a part of Hewlett Packard, develops networking hardware and software. My work was specifically for the Network Management software business unit. The products included AirWave and ClearPass.

Click on a link below to view a PDF of that individual writing sample.

  • ClearPass Policy Manager User Guide
  • ClearPass Policy Manager API
  • AirWave Installation Guide
  • AirWave 7.7 User Guide
